scope: One grouped-OOF-only Phase 0.5 keep/reject test. This contract does not authorize held-out label access, held-out prediction, another residual design, or challenge-data use.

join_and_preflight.verification_order: Before parsing a target as numeric or computing any score, verify both manifest file hashes, schemas, declared output hashes, and aggregate hashes against this contract and the retained files.
join_and_preflight.local_selection: Select family=similarity_knn and configuration_id=tanimoto-k50-p2 from retained_oof_observations.csv.
join_and_preflight.failure_rule: Reject missing, duplicate, extra, non-1:1, misaligned, nonfinite, or provenance-mismatched rows before scoring.

topology_audit.source_disclosure: The research CSV contains authorized grouped-OOF training targets. The topology audit consumed only task, fold, family, and nearest-neighbor similarity fields.
topology_audit.threshold_equality_disclosure: Rows at exactly 0.50 are in the supported population but receive weight 0 and exactly reproduce the base prediction.

candidate.name: similarity_shrunk_knn_residual
candidate.abstention: Rows with nearest_neighbor_similarity < 0.5 receive weight 0 and exactly reproduce the base prediction.

controls.permutation_algorithm: For each namespace and group, sort source row indexes by the tuple (SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 seed|namespace|benchmark|task|inner_fold|molecule_id, molecule_id). Map the source values in that order to target rows in canonical molecule_id order.
controls.shuffled_residual: Permute local-minus-base residuals by the frozen algorithm while preserving each target row's similarity weight.
controls.randomized_family_label: Permute similarity weights by the frozen algorithm while preserving each target row's local-minus-base residual.
controls.classification_boundary: Clip both constructed control predictions to [0, 1] after applying the permuted correction.
controls.selection_rule: Controls are diagnostics only and cannot be selected or retained.

metrics.implementation: Use cypshift.metrics.average_precision for TDC and arithmetic mean absolute error for Octant.

directional_gain.tdc: comparator average precision minus global-only average precision

metrics.bootstrap_group_order: Within each task/population/fold, scaffold_group_hash ascending; members within each group use molecule_id ascending.
metrics.bootstrap_draw_algorithm: For each replicate 0..1999, fold 0..3, and draw position 0..G-1 where G is the number of groups in that fold, SHA-256 UTF-8 seed|scaffold_bootstrap_v1|population|benchmark|task|replicate|fold|draw; interpret the first 8 digest bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer modulo G. Select that group and all of its population rows. Draw independently within each fold with replacement.
metrics.bootstrap_metric_aggregation: Concatenate selected paired rows in fold, draw, then member order and compute one task-level metric per replicate; do not average fold metrics.
metrics.percentile_method: Sort 2,000 directional gains. For probability p, use h=(n-1)*p and linear interpolation between floor(h) and ceil(h). Report p=0.025 and p=0.975.
metrics.dependence_disclosure: Intervals resample scaffold groups within folds and are paired across base, comparator, and target.

retention_rule.direction_and_ties: Every required gain is strict >0 in the declared direction. Zero, equality, or a missing metric fails.
retention_rule.full_population: The valid residual directional point gain over global-only must be strict >0 on all four tasks.
retention_rule.analog_supported_population: The valid residual directional point gain and its scaffold-bootstrap 95% lower bound over global-only must both be strict >0 on all four tasks.
retention_rule.fold_consistency: On all rows in each grouped fold, the valid residual directional point gain over global-only must be strict >0 in at least three of four folds for every task.
retention_rule.remote_population: For similarity <0.50, every valid residual prediction must equal the base float exactly and the remote-population metric must tie exactly.
retention_rule.negative_controls: For each control and each task on both full and supported populations, valid residual minus control directional point performance must be strict >0: control MAE minus valid MAE for Octant, valid AP minus control AP for TDC. A tie fails.
retention_rule.decision: Retain only if every condition passes. Otherwise record the negative result and remove the residual implementation.
